content: Please use this page to input board review questions into our board review database. Select the category or categories that the question belongs to by clicking on all applicable options. Indicate the difficulty level of the question by selecting the appropriate radio button. Enter the exact title of the associated WikiDoc page in the designated field, ensuring that the case matches precisely. Provide the patient history or background information by typing or pasting it into the box below. Type the board review question in the designated box below. Enter the possible answers as follows: Type answer A in the corresponding box below. Type answer B in the corresponding box below. Type answer C in the corresponding box below. Type answer D in the corresponding box below. Type answer E in the corresponding box below. Specify the correct answer by typing either A, B, C, D, or E in the appropriate box below. You may include an image in your question by uploading a file in JPG, GIF, PNG, or SVG format. To upload images, use the following options: Upload Image 1 by clicking here. Upload Image 2 by clicking here. Upload Image 3 by clicking here. Additionally, you can enhance your question by uploading a flash video file to include flash video content.
